thread:
emma: heads-up — we're getting customer reports of 5xx from hosted inference starting ~09:42 UTC after the morning deploy. spike in errors and timeouts from us-west1.
jyoti: which customer? tickets show timeouts + billing alerts. ticket #CAS-3456 from AuroraApps reported 25 failures in 10m.
avery: confirmed AuroraApps (us-west1) — 503s with short-lived retries, app saw higher latency and billing anomalies.
marc: logs show gateway returning 503 with backend error 'auth: keystore not found' and then a cascade. snippet:
```
2026-03-17T09:42:11Z gateway INFO request_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate backend_error="keystore not found" status=503
2026-03-17T09:42:12Z backend WARN token_sign: lookup failed path=/kube/keys/aurora-apps err="not found"
```
oliver: from infra side — the canary deployed an env var KEYSTORE_OVERRIDE that points to a staging KMS path. canary config diff shows:
```
env:
  - KEYSTORE_OVERRIDE=/kms/staging/aurora
```
emma: that would explain the keystore misses — staging path doesn't exist in prod account. is that flag scoped to canary only?
oliver: yes it's scoped to seedweight=10 but routing ended up hitting some prod pods because of sticky session edge cases.
marc: reproducer: curl against canary route with tenant header -> 503
```
curl -H "x-tenant: aurora" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -v
```
jyoti: customers are asking for ETA and possible rollback. SLA ticket opened.
avery: recommended customer mitigation: pin to dedicated model route or use private endpoint — but need faster fix.
emma: plan: 1) disable canary routing (prevent traffic to new pods), 2) roll back env var, 3) confirm auth smoke, 4) update ticket and issue credits. marc can you do rollback? oliver you flip routing?
marc: starting rollback now — `/deploy rollback canary-2026-03-17-09` — will watch for 5xx drop.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by marc at 2026-03-17T09:47:05Z. jobs: rollback-canary-2026-03-17-09 (status: in_progress)
oliver: disabled canary route weight and removed KEYSTORE_OVERRIDE from pod template. pushing patch to rollout-controller.
marc: rollback complete, deployment stabilized. metrics: 5xx rate for aurora down from 8% -> 0.6% in 5m window.
avery: updated ticket CAS-3456: root cause env var in canary pointed to non-prod keystore; rollback applied; offered 24h service credit.
emma: follow-ups: add a pre-deploy smoke that exercises auth for any env var touching KEYS/KMS, add a lint to fail deploy if KEYSTORE_OVERRIDE set without matching KMS path in the prod keystore list, and make canary routing stricter for seedweight sticky sessions.
jyoti: I'll schedule customer postmortem call and include billing statement. also create a runbook section for "keystore env drift".
emma: thanks. tagging eng-oncall for visibility @marc @oliver. closing thread when docs and runbook PRs are up. :white_check_mark:
